task: Pick up the blue cube and place it in the white box.
object: blue G-Research foam die (soft cube, ~6 cm edge from tape photo, +-0.5 cm; logo side up)
container: white open lunch box: outer ~19.5 x 10.3 cm (tape photos, +-0.5 cm), inner depth 4.0 cm (measured), inner ~18.5 x 9.5 cm (estimated). Placed on the bare wooden table outside the mat's lower-right corner: centre 35 cm from the B601 base yaw axis, 67 deg right of straight ahead (mat coordinates ~(53.0, -1.8); corners 31-41 cm from the axis, 2.5 cm right of the mat edge). Long side PERPENDICULAR to the base->box line, so the W2L fingers (open left-right at neutral wrist, user-confirmed) open along the long side: ~10.6 cm span holding the 6 cm cube, ~12-13 cm when releasing, < ~18.5 cm inner length, so the cube can be lowered into the box before release. Mirror option on the left: (-11.4, -1.8). Four corners taped. Far-end placement beyond row C (~51 cm) was rejected: with the longer PX6D+R8+W2L tool (user-measured J6 flange to fingertip ~24 cm on 2026-10-15; repo nominal 26 cm along link6; stock gripper 16.6 cm) and a vertical gripper the nominal horizontal reach limit is ~50-52 cm at full stretch.

grid.description: The 9 points printed on the mat's black dashed frame: 4 corners, 4 edge midpoints and the centre cross; no tape needed. Rows A/B/C go from NEAR (arm side) to FAR; columns 1/2/3 go LEFT to RIGHT as seen from behind the arm looking forward. Place the cube centre on the point, +-1 cm.
grid.yaw_definition: 0 = cube faces parallel to the frame edges; 45 = rotated 45 deg; logo side up

episode_structure: start: arm at supported zero pose, gripper near-closed (J7 raw 1.195-1.275), leader at neutral

FIRST ~1 s: lift the gripper straight up and back to the same fixed 'look' pose every time (at zero pose the W2L fingers hide cubes at A1/B1 from both cameras; this segment is independent of the cube position)
return leader to neutral/zero and hold still until the run ends
accept_rules: cube ends inside box and released
no regrasp of more than one retry
no sensor fault, mirror outcome completed

collection.pilot_note: 2 pilot episodes (cells B2 yaw0, A1 yaw45) go to a separate session and are not part of the 50.

evaluation.in_distribution_note: 9 frame points + 6 midpoints between points (e.g. AB12 = centre of A1,A2,B1,B2); midpoints lie inside the black frame but are never used as exact start positions

out_of_distribution.note: replaces C2 +5 cm far, whose cube edge (y 30.9) left the 29.7 cm mat
1 cm nearer so the cube (y 8-14) clears the red square (y from ~14.9)
replaces C3 +5 cm right, which overlapped the green/purple squares; 45 deg half-diagonal 4.24 cm keeps y <= 13.2 below green (~14.9)

evaluation.policy_order: rotate ACT/DP/VLA per position so no policy always goes first
evaluation.out_of_distribution_note: positional OOD = outside the black dashed frame (about 3-5 cm), chosen so a 6 cm cube (45 deg: 4.24 cm half-diagonal) stays on the mat and off the colour squares; coordinates are photo estimates, check by placing the cube on site

mat.name: Fashion Star white A3 desk mat, 42 x 29.7 cm
mat.coordinates: x from the mat LEFT edge, y from the mat BOTTOM edge (camera-icon edge, facing the arm); cm, read from tape photos, +-0.5 cm
mat.placement: camera-icon edge toward B601. Nominal: centre cross straight ahead of the base yaw axis, 30-35 cm from it (bottom edge 13-18 cm from the axis). The mat MAY be shifted LEFT (away from the box) by 0-10 cm; the site decides, and the actual offset is recorded per episode (episode.py --mat-offset-cm). Arm and box stay put relative to the base; only the mat moves. If the box is placed on the left instead, mirror the rule (shift right). Four corners taped to the table plus locating lines along two edges; QR code and logo left uncovered.
mat.colour_squares: red (lower left, x~5.4-10.3) and green (lower right, x~31.2-36.2) at the cross depth; yellow (upper left) and purple (upper right) centred at y~24.5; each ~5x5 cm. Not T1 targets (start points in columns 1/3 are only ~5 cm from the red/green squares); reserved for T2

lateral_offset.recorded_in: episode meta.json: mat_offset_cm (signed, + = mat to the arm's LEFT); use 12.3 for the 2026-10-15 setup
lateral_offset.effect: in mat coordinates the base axis becomes (20.8+offset, -15.5) and the box centre (53.0+offset, -1.8); farthest training start C1 goes from 39.2 cm (0) to 42.4 cm (10) from the base axis; the left mirror box option overlaps the mat once offset > ~2 cm
lateral_offset.why_not_right: shifting toward the box makes the mat overlap the box footprint; the box would have to move further round toward the base
lateral_offset.actual_setup_20261015: Measured in the pilot reach check (datasets/il_vla_benchmark/t1_pilot_20261015/episodes/ep000_*, MJCF FK of dwell poses, nominal 26 cm tool, +-2 cm): A1 (34.0,+21.1) A3 (35.4,+4.1) C1 (44.2,+19.6) C3 (45.6,+4.4) cm in the base frame (x forward, +y = arm's left). Centre cross ~40 cm forward and ~12 cm to the arm's LEFT (planned 30-35 cm straight ahead). Box corners reached at 39-52 cm, box centre ~(38,-22) cm; long side ~79 deg to the base->box line. All corners and box reachable. An earlier note here claiming the mat lay to the arm's right was a misreading of the camera image.

revision: 2026-10-15: start grid moved from a taped 20x20 cm 10 cm-pitch grid to the 9 printed points of the Fashion Star mat frame (user-confirmed via side session); cube size corrected to ~6 cm. No episodes had been recorded before this change. OOD positions revised the same day to stay on the mat and clear of the colour squares. Box moved to 35 cm / 67 deg right of the base with its long side along the finger-opening direction (reach check with the longer wrist tool). Mat may shift left 0-10 cm; actual offset recorded per episode. Actual placement: mat ~12 cm to the arm's left, cross ~40 cm forward (pilot reach check); offset record-only; episodes start with a fixed lift to a look pose. Episode duration 45 -> 55 s (first formal episode used 43 s of motion); episode index auto-advances.

container_cm.note: centre_mat_xy and base_axis_mat_xy are for mat_offset_cm = 0; add the offset to both x values
